india.label: India
india.notes: A4 paper. A photo is optional and off by default; many employers and portals do not need one. Leave out date of birth, marital status, religion, parents' names, ID numbers, and the full street address.

us_canada.label: United States and Canada
us_canada.notes: Letter paper. Photos are usually left off because employers avoid appearance-based bias, and many reject resumes that include one. Leave out date of birth, marital status, and similar personal details.

uk.label: United Kingdom
uk.notes: A4 paper. Photos are usually left off for the same bias reasons. Leave out date of birth, marital status, and similar personal details.

eu.label: Europe (EU)
eu.notes: A4 paper. Practice differs by country: a photo is customary in some countries and discouraged in others. Off by default; turn it on only if the posting or local practice expects it.

gulf.label: Gulf countries
gulf.notes: A4 paper. A photo and the nationality line are often expected by employers in this region, but it varies. Photo is still off by default; turn it on if the posting or recruiter asks.

other.label: Other or unknown
other.notes: A4 paper. Photo off by default. Ask the user for the job's country to choose a better region.
